name: const unsafe fn as_uninit_slice_mut < 'a > (self) -> & 'a mut [MaybeUninit < T >]
rule: Even if the result is unused, the caller must enforce Rust's aliasing rules for the returned lifetime 'a, which is arbitrarily chosen and need not reflect the data's actual lifetime; while the returned reference exists, the pointed-to memory must not be read or written through any other pointer.
